description: The file defines a Kotlin source file for an Android Compose UI component named ChatComposer. It manages the chat input area, including text input, attachments, action buttons, and related UI logic, for an Android app using Jetpack Compose.

classes.name: DraftApplication
classes.description: Data class representing a draft message state, including input text, last applied draft, and whether it was consumed.

methods.name: applyDraftText
methods.description: Function to determine whether to apply a draft text to the chat input, updating the draft state accordingly.

methods.name: ChatComposer
methods.description: Composable function that renders a chat input UI, managing message input, attachments, action buttons, and draft handling.

methods.name: SecondaryActionButton
methods.description: Reusable Composable button for secondary actions like Attach, Refresh, Abort within the chat UI.

methods.name: ThinkingMenuItem
methods.description: Composable for an item in the thinking level dropdown menu.

methods.name: thinkingLabel
methods.description: Utility function to get a display label for different thinking levels.

methods.name: AttachmentsStrip
methods.description: Displays a horizontal scroll list of attachments.

methods.name: AttachmentChip
methods.description: Displays a UI chip for an attachment with a removal button.

methods.name: chatTextFieldColors
methods.description: Defines color scheme for the chat text input field.

methods.name: mobileBodyStyle
methods.description: Defines text style used for text in the compose UI components.
